questions.question: If there is an SA1 fault at input wire A then the boolean function for parity bit is _____
In the case of 3-bit even even parity generator,When all the inputs are high and 'A' is stuck at __ output is __
How many types of parity bits are found?
Which of the following is the correct Boolean expression for an even parity generator using three input variables?

explanations.c: An even parity generator adds a bit that makes the total number of 1's (including the parity bit) even. XORing the inputs like A ⊕ B ⊕ C does exactly that—it outputs 1 when the number of 1's in A, B, and C is odd.
